rules.rows: one per name with sessions/<pid>.json AND states/<name>.STATE.md; lead-1 has no STATE.md so no IC row
rules.order: IC rows in name order, never session file order, so an IC keeps its letter when it restarts under a new pid; then lead-1 workflows by start time
rules.parse: key: value at line start, in or out of a fence; key = text before the first ': '; last occurrence wins; missing = '-'
rules.cut: none: rung and needs_you are the STATE.md values in full; the pane cuts a row line at its own width
rules.updated_at: parsed from 'YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM BST' at the start of updated:; null when no time is given
rules.newest_file: the newest file beside STATE.md other than STATE.md and dotfiles; '-' when there is none
